description: Two linear keys: frame 0 at the rest place, frame 40 one hip height (0.8698308 m) forward (-Y). The root's rest head is (0, -0.0108229, 0.0504142). Sliding the whole animation 1 m forward moves the root on frame 40 to y = -0.0108229 - 0.8698308 - 1 = -1.8806537, on frame 0 to -1.0108229, and on frame 20 (halfway) to their mean -1.4457383; height is unchanged. The pose does not change: upperleg01.L stays at root + (0.1019421, 0.0028925, -0.0114742) = (0.1019421, -1.0079304, 0.0389400) on frame 0. Then a 90 degree turn about the root on frame 0 (the default pivot, (0, -1.0108229)): (x, y) -> (-y, x) about it. The upper leg goes to root + (-0.0028925, 0.1019421, -0.0114742) = (-0.0028925, -0.9088808, 0.0389400), and frame 40's root, 0.8698308 m ahead along -Y, ends 0.8698308 m along +X: (0.8698308, -1.0108229, 0.0504142). Undo takes the turn back. Physics off, so the keyed poses are the ones shown.
